name: Columbia County, WA
findings: Columbia County has 21 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Columbia County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Columbia County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
